intro:
Good morning commander. I'm going to make a brief introduction of the present situation. The North Korean Peoples Army have crossed the 38th paralel, striking the ROK forces alongside the frontier. So, the situation is hopeless and some people including the president Truman are believing that this is the beginning of the 3rd World War... The forces of the Republic of Korea with their outdated equipment and few soldiers are not able to stop the Soviet equiped North Korean forces which are now at the gates of the capital of South Korea; Seoul. It's sure that we won't be able to hold Seoul for too long, however we will need some time to make an organised retreat of the ROK forces.

Your task is; manage the ROK forces to avoid a quick victory of the NKPA forces over Seoul. Fortunately, a US task force will help you from the turn 5. (You will receive enough prestige to build your task force in the 5th turn).

Good luck commander!

intro:
The withdrawal continues commander, and the situation has not any sight to be changed for now. The North Korean forces have arrived to the North of the important city of Taejon, which is surrounded by the Kum river.

Your mission this time is again to get enough time to make a good retreat to the South. You should establish a defensive line on the South bank of the Kum river, to gain enough time to save as much units as possible. Taejon must not fall until the established time, otherwise the remain units in other parts will be surrounded and surely defeated.

Good Luck.

NOTE: Deployment zone is limited to 8 hexes.

intro:
Please, sit down general... The NKPA forces have conquered the most of the Korean peninsula. Now, the U.N. forces are trying to resist in the Pusan Perimeter. This area is established around the important port of Pusan, the last capital of the Republic of Korea. Pusan must not fall at any costs!, otherwise, the Communists will be victorious and Korea entirely unified under the communist sign of North Korea.

Your task is to resist the North Korean strike, and then, stage a counterattack to break the enemy lines. Our 8th Army have received some reinforcements like some M26 Pershing tanks and other units which will be a great help to deal with the commies.

Good luck commander!.

intro:
If this operation is not finally sucessful, surely Harry will claim for my head!! hehe. Well, you are the proper commander to land on Inch'on, the traditional port of Seoul. Yes, you are right, the plans are to free Seoul from the North Koreans while they are busy at the Pusan Perimeter. A success in Inch'on, will mean that the NKPA forces will be in a complete disarray.

Intelligence reports that the enemy forces are consisting of mainly rookie units of two divisions which are currently still in the making.

Your mission is; land at Inch'on and then drive to Seoul. Liberate the capital from the Communists.

Good Luck!!!.

NOTE: Deployment zone is limited to 8 hexes.

intro:
Good morning, commander. The U.N. forces have completely turned the situation, now we are in front of the North Korean capital. The perimeter of Pyongyang it's defended only by a few enemy divisions, but beware!; the North Koreans still have many U.N. POWs in the nearly areas of Pyongyang, and they can execute them, so a fast action it's mandatory there.

Take Pyongyang as soon as possible, and free the prisoners taking the North Korean capital city from the commies. Also take care: the North Korean soldiers will act as guerrillas as soon as their units become into disarray.

Good luck.

NOTE: Deployment zone is limited to 10 hexes.
